To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a phased array of many reflectors antennas is an effective solution for improving the uplink power budget of a deep space communication ground station, and that an in-orbit radar calibration technique is effective in providing frequent calibration opportunities for the array phase centers.
The proposed array calibration procedure is feasible and provides a high-quality phase calibration for the array of large reflector antennas.

The proposed calibration method is capable to provide the array gain degradation of less then 1dB for the array of modest size reflectors with the number of elements in the order of 10-20, and the number of targets in the order of several hundreds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a phased array of many small reflectors antennas for the uplink of a deep-space communications network.
the design of the phased array of large reflector antennas for deep-space communications.
the development of a phased array of large reflector antennas for deep-space communication applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed calibration procedure is very efficient and can be used to provide high accuracy array phase distribution and thus to achieve a high gain of the array.

the phased array of large reflector antennas can provide a very high effective isotropic radiating power for deep-space communication and the array can be calibrated in-orbit with modest-sized targets using the proposed calibration procedure.
a phased array of large reflector antennas is an effective way to improve uplink power and to provide a reliable deep-space communication system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phased-array calibration procedure for deep-space communication can be successfully implemented.
the array gain degradation due to the errors in array phase distribution is negligible and the array gain is limited only by the array elements position error and the in-orbit target positions error.
a phased array of large reflector antennas for uplink communication with deep-space spacecrafts can be calibrated by a number of in- orbit calibration targets.
